Sandbox_BritasArmorPackB42_EnableNightVi: Turns this pack's night vision, battery actions and battery drain on or off. Clothing and installed batteries are kept. This does not add Brita goggle support to another framework. Restart after changing.
Sandbox_BritasArmorPackB42_ReloadCarrier: Add reload bonus for Brita carriers

Adds the standard 15 percent bonus for supported Brita carriers missed by the original calculation. Disable if another mod manages reload bonuses. Safety checks and bonuses already granted by the game remain active.
Sandbox_NVFramework_BatterySystemEnabled: This integrated repair always requires an installed, charged battery. Old saves that stored this option as disabled are migrated automatically.
Sandbox_NVFramework_BatteryDrainMultipli: Controls how quickly installed night-vision batteries drain. 1.0 gives about 12 in-game hours; 2.0 drains twice as fast; 0.5 drains half as fast.
Sandbox_NVFramework_ItemSpawnMultiplier_: Scales procedural spawn weights only for example night-vision items added by the framework. 1.0 is default, 2.0 doubles the weight and 0.0 disables framework-added spawns.
Sandbox_NVFramework_UseLightConeInSingle: Use directional light cone in singleplayer
When enabled, singleplayer uses the attached directional light-cone helper. When disabled, it uses the fallback lamppost-based lighting mode.
